mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEAM3_202407F.STORE ( STORE_NO, STORE_ADDR1, STORE_ZIP, STORE_NM, STORE_ADDR2, STORE_OPEN_DATE, STORE_STATUS ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(STORE_NO), 0) + 1 FROM TEAM3_202407F.STORE), #{storeAddr1}, #{storeZip}, #{storeNm}, #{storeAddr2}, #{storeOpenDate}, 'Y' )
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE SET STORE_ADDR1 = #{storeAddr1}, STORE_ZIP = #{storeZip}, STORE_NM = #{storeNm}, STORE_ADDR2 = #{storeAddr2}, store_open_date = #{storeOpenDate} WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo}
mapper.select: select * from ( SELECT s.store_nm, s.store_no, s.store_addr1, s.store_addr2, s.store_zip, s.store_open_date, s.store_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) as year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE) as month, NVL(total, 0) as total, NVL(monthlyAvg, 0) as monthlyAvg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY NVL(monthlyAvg, 0) DESC) as rank FROM store s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.store_no, SUM(store_order_amount * store_order_price) as total, AVG(store_order_amount * store_order_price) as monthlyAvg FROM store s LEFT JOIN store_order so ON s.store_no = so.store_no LEFT JOIN store_order_detail sd ON so.store_order_no = sd.store_order_no WHERE so.store_order_status = 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM store_order_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM store_order_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE) GROUP BY s.store_no ) h ON s.store_no = h.store_no where s.store_status='Y' ORDER BY monthlyAvg DESC, store_no ) where rank <=5
